values.en: Proof irrelevance asserts that any two proofs h₁ and h₂ of the same proposition P are equal. Here it is presented explicitly as an axiom. Lean builds proof irrelevance into its kernel; other CIC-style systems may require a separate principle. It does not follow from impredicativity alone.
values.zh-CN: 证明无关性断言：同一命题 P 的任意两个证明 h₁ 与 h₂ 都相等。此处将它明确表述为一条公理。Lean 将证明无关性内建于内核中；其他 CIC 风格系统可能需要额外原则。证明无关性并不能仅由非直谓性推出。
